capabilities: Show absolute, relative, or hybrid line numbers in markdown files
Highlight the active editor line and gutter number
Display cursor line and column in the status bar
Control line numbers in canvas text cards
extras: README includes screenshots of the line number modes and status bar display.
problem: Obsidian's editor has no built-in line-number gutter or cursor position display, which matters for vim-style navigation and precise editing.
summary: Editor plugin that shows absolute, relative, or hybrid line numbers, highlights the active line, and shows cursor position in the status bar.
